explanation: The holy building in Jerusalem that Jesus predicts will be destroyed, symbolizing the end of the old covenant era.
Events or occurrences indicating that God's judgment and Jesus' return are near.
Impostors who claim to be the Savior to deceive people in the last days.
Conflicts between nations that Jesus mentions as part of the birth pains before the end comes.
Instances where believers suffer and face death because of their confession of faith in Christ.
The message about God's kingdom that must be preached to all nations before the great end occurs.
A term describing peoples or nations outside the Jewish people, often used in connection with occupation and warfare against Jerusalem.
An expression for a great catastrophe that will strike the temple and the city, marked by God's wrath against sin.
A cosmic sign where the sun loses its brightness, symbolizing the collapse of the world order at the end times.
A title Jesus uses for himself to describe his ascension and return in glory with angels.
Holy beings who will gather the elect from all corners of the earth when the time comes.
A geographical place where Jesus spoke about these events, often associated with prophecies about the future.
A state of spiritual readiness and alertness that the disciples must have since they do not know the day or the hour.
